drhp.business: The Company manufactures HDPE/PP bags and agricultural-grade zinc sulphate and related products at its facility in Village Keshurehai, Shahjahanpur, and is also engaged in retail and wholesale trading of fertilizers and crop seeds, along with farming activities on surplus land adjoining its factory premises.
drhp.end_markets: fertilizer and allied sectors|agricultural input industry
drhp.expansion: The Company continued to strengthen its operating base and asset capacity during FY2025-26, with Property, Plant and Equipment increasing and Capital Work-in-Progress outstanding as at 31st March 2026. The Company also increased its shareholding in subsidiary Polyfirm Packaging Private Limited from 60% to 90% during the year, and subsequent to year-end incorporated a new subsidiary, Orchha Hospitality And Retreat Private Limited, to diversify into hospitality, tourism, hotels, resorts, infrastructure development and recreation.

sk.overview: The agrochemicals (crop protection) industry covers the development, manufacture and distribution of insecticides, herbicides, fungicides and plant growth regulators in Formulations and Technicals form. Per the issuer-commissioned ICRA Report (February 2026), the sector is supported by resilient Indian agriculture (healthy reservoir levels, robust crop production sustaining rural demand), a global 'China+1' shift favouring Indian chemical manufacturing, and sustained government fiscal support to agriculture and manufacturing.
sk.schemes: Make in India|Production Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme (incl. bulk drugs / KSM / API, total outlay Rs 6,940 crore FY2021-FY2030)|Bharat Vistar multilingual AI advisory platform (Union Budget)|Coconut Promotion Scheme and cashew-cocoa initiatives|PM Gati Shakti, National Logistics Policy, Dedicated …
sk.structure: The DRHP frames agrochemicals within globally dispersed supply chains for raw materials, intermediates and finished products, subject to tariff and trade-flow sensitivity. India is positioned as a beneficiary of 'China+1'/'Europe+1' localisation, with import substitution supported by PLI schemes …

risks.body:

- Liquidity, credit and interest rate risks affecting capital management and funding requirements.
- Changes in and compliance with applicable environmental, safety, labour, corporate and other regulatory requirements.

- Technology-related disruptions, information systems risks and potential interruptions to business operations.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Capacity expansion: evaluate opportunities to expand manufacturing capacities and enhance production infrastructure to meet growing market requirements.
- Product development: strengthen the portfolio of agricultural inputs, micronutrients and allied products.
- Market development: strengthen dealer and distribution network, expand market reach and improve customer engagement.
- Subsidiary development: support and monitor subsidiary operations and pursue opportunities complementing the existing business.
- Operational efficiency: cost optimization, efficient resource utilization, inventory management …
